extraction.Name: Peter LeQlair
extraction.Recorded patent: Yes, filed for record by Allottee
extraction.NOTES: Patent delivered at Agency Office after released from Army; receipted for: Yes; price received: $10,000.00, described as 'Good price at that time' and 'a fair consideration'; land sold in Summer of 1918; date of redemption expired: none; tax assessments or tax sales: none canceled or paid; wife and four minor children dependent upon allottee; notarized November 20, 1928 in Kay County, Oklahoma; health good, no funds; both parties of Ponca City, Okla.
